task.title: Create a Note
task.shortdesc: Create a new note in your NoteForge library.

context.p: You must be signed in before you can create notes.

step.cmd: Tap the + button in the top-right corner of the notes library screen.
Type your note title in the Title field, then tap anywhere below to begin writing the note body.
Tap Done to save the note.

taskbody.result: Your new note appears in your library and is synced to all your devices automatically.
